turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: the very first time: 1. Open the box. 2. Pull the plastics flap to unseal the mattress. 3. Unroll and place on your bed frame or foundation. 4. Use a pair of scissors to remove the plastic wrap. 5. Cut carefully along the plastic edges, making sure not to damage your mattress cover. 6. Your Endy will expand back to its regular size and will be ready to sleep on right away. It’ll reach full firmness in about a week, and you can sleep on it immediately (using it right away won’t cause any damage).
